D1-M01: The Spah's charges destroyed two of the Procession's four Cultist Troopers in Round 2, and from then on the Spah held the centre and the left; a 10 RP Sagdid Hound-Keepers scored 9.8 VP on the left. The Procession killed 80 RP to the 30 it lost, but from Round 4 its only unit on an objective was The Pontifex of Acedia.
D1-M02: The Warhost's Corporaider Squads and Black Huskarls stood on all three objectives in Round 1, before the Cohort reached any, then charged the Legionnaire Squads down one by one. Corporaider Squad 1 held the right all battle for 13.4 VP; the Cohort lost six units (162 RP) to the Warhost's one (28 RP).
D1-M03: Caesar and the Palatine Custos (Mounted), now OC 2 a model, took the centre from Round 3 and held it. But the Convent's ten units held both flanks, and a 10 RP Covenant Levies from Troop Requisition walked onto the empty right and held it for three rounds (8.3 VP). The first playing ended 32-4; this one 34-23.
D1-M04: The Etna's Ferricants held the centre from Round 2 and retook the left in Round 5, but no Etna unit ever went to the right, where the House of Glass Arcanist - one 5 HP model - scored 2 VP a round for four rounds. IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS paid the Fencibles' ten units 9 VP, and the battle went to them by 4.
D1-M05: The Hundred led 21-12 after Round 3 with cheap Veche Levies on the centre and the left, then lost four OC units and scored 3 VP in the last three rounds. The Peijaiset Wardens held the right in every scored round (12.1 VP); the round cap stopped the Song at 29 in Round 5, and the Wardens' charge for INTO THE FRAY ended it in Round 6.
D1-M06: The Oath took all three objectives in Round 1 and led 18-7 after Round 2, then lost Tadeusz Kosciuszko, the Silesian Hammerguards and all three Commonwealth Fusiliers (156 RP, to the Legion's 10). The Legion held the left with Covenant Levies 3 and, from Round 4, the centre with the Archistrategos' pair; the Oath's two Consecrated Hussars could not hold three objectives.
